name: cadre-lifecycle-core
description: Forge-agnostic Agentic SDLC lifecycle governance (G1-G10 gates) for the Cadre role suite: conversational onboarding and generic gate-decision skills, plus a kernel bootstrap script. Optional companion to the cadre plugin. For GitHub- or GitLab-flavored gate approvals, also install cadre-lifecycle-github / cadre-lifecycle-gitlab.

interface.shortDescription: Forge-agnostic Agentic SDLC lifecycle governance for the Cadre suite.
interface.longDescription: Conversationally onboard a project onto G1-G10 lifecycle gates and record gate decisions, without touching a CLI, YAML, or JSON directly. Optional companion to the cadre plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use lifecycle-onboarding to set up Agentic SDLC lifecycle tracking for this project.
Use lifecycle-review to record a gate decision.

kernelInstall.title: Kernel install mode
kernelInstall.description: How to obtain the Agentic SDLC kernel. 'auto' (default) lets this plugin install and manage its own copy under its data directory. 'system' uses only a kernel you installed yourself and never installs anything. 'off' disables the check entirely -- set AGENTIC_SDLC_BIN yourself. Unrecognized values are treated as 'auto'.

profile.title: Provider profile
profile.description: Provider profile id passed to `agentic-sdlc init`, e.g. secure-cloud. Leave blank for kernel-only lifecycle operation with no profile.
